points_note: PSN trophy points: Platinum 300, Gold 90, Silver 30, Bronze 15. Total 300 + 2x90 + 6x30 + 46x15 = 1350.

grade_note: Maximum Withdrawal is Silver in Insider Gaming, Radio Times, GTABase, EGamers, GuideDistrict, GTAScoop, AlcastHQ and OfZenAndComputing (6 Silver / 46 Bronze split holds); Push Square alone lists it as Bronze, which would break the reported 1-2-6-46 split, so Silver is used here.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — in practice the last one is usually A Long Road (100% completion). There is no separate task; work through the 54 below and this follows.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Pure story — it pops naturally and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Story trophy, unmissable. (Name shown exactly as listed by PSN and the guides, with the censored word.)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. After the credits you keep free roam of Leonida, and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks — the real cleanup starts here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable as part of the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (unlocked after the story; Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion). You do not need literally everything — e.g. 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 70 of the 80 Challenges, and only part of most collectibles (reported: 100 of 255 animals, 200 of 277 vehicles). This is the long grind, ~200 hours for the Platinum in total, and normally the last trophy before the Platinum pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts and find spots at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots. Just over half the total is enough — pick the easy jumps and bridge flights first.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. Sample one of everything as you explore — racing, shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade, and the rest — and it pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero). Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold; some are locked until you meet their conditions, shown on the map. Track at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Locations are at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race repeatedly does not count. Track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most race spots let you hire a car; watch its Rating, and buy upgrades at Mod Shops if you race your own car.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early on Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area until you land one big enough — you need a boat with a fishing rod, and there are plenty to hijack nearby if you do not own one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and play one arcade game through to completion. Any arcade game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Andy's story missions; the trophy pops after his final mission. Stranger missions stay available in free roam, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's missions through to the finale, 'Maritime Disputes'. Stranger missions stay available in free roam, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's missions through to the finale, 'Hometown Heroes'. Stranger missions stay available in free roam, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Work through the stranger contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest) — finishing their strands also feeds their individual trophies above.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Randy's missions. His strand involves a vehicle wish list — Push Square links a Randy's Wish List vehicle locations guide to help you through it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Tyrone's missions. Kitty Litter lab locations help you progress his strand (Push Square links a locations guide).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MEDITATE AT EVERY SPOT — AND DO IT EARLY. There are 18 meditation spots; a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played, so do not walk away mid-session. One spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, which is why GTABase and PowerPyx flag this as the ONLY possibly missable trophy in the game. Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; discovered spots show at Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Follow the hunt markers — it is a tracked stranger-style task, not random wildlife.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress. Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Going for 100% needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up) and scan 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. Scan everything you pass and it adds up fast.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges (skill-based feats listed at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges). 70 are needed for 100% completion, so keep pushing past 50 if you are going for the Platinum.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape until the heat dies down. Do it in open country with a fast car waiting — losing the cops at 4 stars in the city is the hard part.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — keep the heat on and keep moving, shop to shop, without getting busted or escaping clean. Plan a route of three close shops and a fast getaway car.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — you discover one by getting inside it or scanning it. This comes naturally through the story; track what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles and mop up rare spawns in free roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus during a fight with a group of enemies and drop 5 of them before it ends. Pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies and line the shots up while focus is active.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA (Vice City International Airport), leave in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without following the normal departure. Expect heat on the runway, so be quick.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Tied to the Rhino tanks — engage them in the open world. The guides list the trophy but do not yet spell out the exact trigger in detail; expect it to involve taking on Rhinos at high wanted levels. Marked partial until a guide confirms the precise method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms tripped, no witnesses spotting you. Go quiet, go at a quiet hour, and get out before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': follow a security van to its bank and slip into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always bring 4 stars — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. 100% completion needs all 8 vaults; each pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road, crack it open and escape with the cash. Ambush one away from heavy police patrols and have a getaway vehicle ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every named area of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. Drive, fly and sail into each region; the trophy pops once the map is fully revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang. Scout their turf, hit the operation, and get clear before reinforcements arrive.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot, and enjoy it with the view. A pure vibe trophy — sit, sip, pop.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get inside a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big front window and floor it.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through. A nod to the classic GTA IV date activity — just play a frame through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED — the guides list this as a partnership moment with mass appeal, but no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. Likely tied to a partner activity milestone; check back after the community confirms it. Do not rely on a guessed method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED — tied to making choices across story and side content; community reports suggest a cumulative counter, but no published guide has confirmed the exact count or trigger. Make choices as you play and it should pop; the precise requirement is still being verified.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED — 'second time's the charm' points to succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no published guide has confirmed exactly what. Keep it in mind during failed-then-retried moments; the precise trigger is still being verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED — KeenGamer lists this as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method. It is tied to witnessing something strange in the world; the exact event is still being confirmed by players. Do not rely on a guessed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED — a melee drive-by that bowls targets over; KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed. The idea is a drive-by using a melee weapon, but the exact conditions are not yet verified in a published guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Dirty cash from robberies is marked — clean it through contacts over time and the total adds up; bank vault hauls (up to $205,000 each) feed this nicely.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, anything. Find shops on the map at Touch Pad > Style. It adds up naturally if you buy gear and upgrades as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties ($160,000 total) via the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Garages store vehicles registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop (needs an empty parking spot; buy garages for more). Scooter Bros then delivers your repaired, registered vehicles to you for a small fee.
